title: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications: Defense & Mitigation
description: A security engineering course detailing prompt injection, insecure output handling, sensitive data leakage, system prompt theft, and dual-LLM guardrail architectures.
body: Protect AI applications from modern attack vectors. Learn how to defend against direct and indirect prompt injection, implement dual-LLM guardrails, sanitize LLM HTML output, and redact PII.

lessons.title: Lesson 1.1: Direct Jailbreaks vs. Indirect Prompt Injection
lessons.body:
### Attack Vectors
- **Direct Injection:** Malicious user prompt designed to override system instructions.
- **Indirect Injection:** Malicious payload hidden inside untrusted RAG documents (uploaded PDFs, scraped web content).

lessons.title: Lesson 2.1: Python Dual-LLM Guardrail Scanner Pattern
lessons.body: Pass all incoming user prompts through a dedicated lightweight guardrail model before execution.

lessons.title: Lesson 2.2: Go Output Sanitization & XSS Defense
lessons.body: Sanitize generated LLM Markdown/HTML content using HTML escaping to eliminate XSS risks.
